title: Diamond Dev configuration
description: Schema for the .diamond-dev.toml workflow configuration file.

repository_url.description: Git remote URL of the implementation repository.

wiki_repository_url.description: Git remote URL of the GitHub Gollum wiki repository. Derived from repository_url when omitted.

format.description: How notification URLs are called: a plain GET, a JSON POST, or a Slack/Discord/ntfy-shaped POST.

initial_implementation_url.description: Called when all initial implementations are pushed.

comparison_url.description: Called when the comparison page is published to the wiki.

comparison_implementation_url.description: Called when comparison follow-up work is pushed.

review_input_needed_url.description: Called when review judgments need human input.

open_pr_url.description: Called when the final pull request is opened.

prompts.description: Prompt override files, relative to the config directory.

initial_implementation_file.description: Override for the initial implementation prompt.

comparison_judgment_file.description: Override for the comparison judgment prompt.

comparison_implementation_file.description: Override for the comparison follow-up prompt.

review_judgment_file.description: Override for the review judgment prompt.

review_fix_file.description: Override for the review fix prompt.

workflow.description: Agent names filling each workflow role.

implementers.description: Two or more agents that implement the plan in parallel.

comparison_judge.description: Agent that writes the comparison page.

comparison_fixer.description: Agent that applies comparison follow-up. Defaults to the first non-accepted implementer.

review_provider.description: Agent that produces the code review.

review_fixer.description: Agent that applies accepted review fixes.

final_reviewer.description: Agent that runs the final interactive PR review.

test_commands.description: Shell commands run per branch; their status and capped output are included in the bundle.

signal_commands.description: Shell commands run per branch whose capped output feeds the judge as extra signals (lint, complexity, coverage).

max_total_diff_bytes.description: Total diff byte budget across all branches.

max_test_output_bytes.description: Byte cap for each test command's captured output.

max_signal_output_bytes.description: Byte cap for each signal command's captured output.

max_wait_seconds.description: Total seconds to wait for acceptance.

agents.description: Per-agent adapter and model settings, keyed by agent name.

adapter.description: Adapter backing this agent (built-in or plugin). Defaults to the agent name.

model.description: Model passed to the agent CLI.
